title: The intersection of two quasi-coherent sheaves of ideals is quasi-coherent
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $\mathcal I,\mathcal J\subseteq\mathcal O_X$ quasi-coherent sheaves of ideals [pqf-def-coherent]. Let $\mathcal I\cap\mathcal J\subseteq\mathcal O_X$ be the sheaf of ideals $U\mapsto\mathcal I(U)\cap\mathcal J(U)$ ($U\subseteq X$ open). Then $\mathcal I\cap\mathcal J$ is a quasi-coherent sheaf of ideals of $\mathcal O_X$; in particular, for every affine open $U\subseteq X$, $(\mathcal I\cap\mathcal J)(U)=\mathcal I(U)\cap\mathcal J(U)$ and $(\mathcal I\cap\mathcal J)|_U=(\mathcal I(U)\cap\mathcal J(U))^\sim$, and these ideals are compatible with localization: for $f\in\mathcal O_X(U)$, $(\mathcal I(U)\cap\mathcal J(U))\mathcal O_X(U)_f=\mathcal I(U)\mathcal O_X(U)_f\cap\mathcal J(U)\mathcal O_X(U)_f$.
